name: B10-0532/2025 (Renew) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Tunisia to stop cracking down on free speech and political opponents. It calls for the release of lawyer Sonia Dahmani, who has been held since May 2024, and of others jailed for speaking out. It also asks Tunisia to scrap a decree used to prosecute journalists and to let judges work independently. Finally, it asks the European Union to tie its money and cooperation with Tunisia to human rights progress.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who is affected:** Tunisia's government, courts, jailed activists and journalists.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to Tunisia's leaders and European Union bodies.
